page.overview:
Who is Aka?

Aka was the eldest child of the , a member of the , and sister to , Gothano, Chi-You, the , Toad Baron, and Kitsune. Unlike most of her siblings, Aka was fond of humans and mutants, considering mutants to be the Pantheon's true children. Aka was friends with the human and assisted her in stopping Kitsune at one point.

Aka was murdered by her own sister Kitsune in Shredder in Hell issue #5, to provide a sacrifice of divine blood to resurrect the Dragon. She later was resurrected, after gathering information warned to warn Kitsune and Oroku Saki about the Rat King's Armageddon Game.

Aka expressed herself as a kind old woman. As the eldest surviving member of the Pantheon, she took her position seriously and loved all her siblings as family.

But unlike most of the Pantheon, Aka also loved and respected humans, considering them to be the Pantheon's true children, and wanted to give humanity a fair chance of succeeding on its own merits. To this end, Aka had befriended and supernaturally aided , a human woman. However, Aka was clear that this fairness she sought for humanity was not a guarantee of their success but merely honoring their right to pursue their own destiny without unfair sabotage, accepting that humanity may still yet die out as a result of their own failures.
